description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger. 
 
 
 Position Purpose: 
 The Workforce Management (WFM) IT team builds and operates the applications, integrations, and cloud infrastructure behind Home Depot's enterprise Workforce Management platform (UKG Pro WFM / Dimensions) and its surrounding ecosystem — including internally-built GCP-hosted applications, Data Hub pipelines, and third-party integrations such as Boomi. As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll work across the full stack: building and maintaining application features (UI and backend), configuring and supporting UKG Pro WFM/Dimensions and its integrations, managing the GCP infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines everything runs on, and partnering directly with UKG Support/Engineering to troubleshoot production issues. 
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 60% Delivers and Executes - Assists in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining software; Follows best practices established by the organization and participates in improvement conversations; Consistently helps the team achieve results, even under tough circumstances
 20% Learns and Grows - Learns through successful and failed experiment when tackling new problems; Actively seeks ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels
 20% Plans and Aligns - Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives; Collaborates with other team members in agile processes; Relates openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people
 
 Direct Manager/Direct Reports: 
 This position typically reports to Software Engineer Manager or Sr. Manager
 This position has 0 Direct Reports
 
 Travel Requirements: 
 No travel required.
 
 Physical Requirements: 
 Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
 
 Working Conditions: 
 Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Must be eighteen years of age or older.
 Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Familiarity with workforce management or HR/payroll systems (UKG Pro WFM/Dimensions or Kronos a plus) 
 Exposure to integration platforms (Dell Boomi or similar) and API-based integrations 
 Exposure to SQL and relational/NoSQL database technology, especially in an ETL/data-pipeline context 
 Exposure to front-end frameworks (React/TypeScript or similar) and backend service development 
 Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GKE/Kubernetes, BigQuery, Cloud Armor, CloudSQL, Cloud Load Balancing) 
 Exposure to CI/CD tooling (Spinnaker or similar), containerization (Docker), and source control (Git/GitHub) 
 Exposure to identity/SSO protocols and migrations (SAML/OIDC, PingFederate, Microsoft Entra ID) 
 Exposure to secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, Google Secret Manager) 
 Familiarity with web application security practices (XSS remediation, hardened container images) 
 Comfortable working directly with vendor support/engineering teams to troubleshoot production issues 
 Interest in applying AI-assisted tooling to engineering workflows 
 
 Minimum Education: 
 The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.
 
 Preferred Education: 
 No additional education
 
 Minimum Years of Work Experience: 
 1
 
 Preferred Years of Work Experience: 
 No additional years of experience
 
 Minimum Leadership Experience: 
 None
 
 Preferred Leadership Experience: 
 None
 
 Certifications: 
 None
 
 Competencies: 
 Global Perspective
 Manages Ambiguity
 Nimble Learning
 Self-Development
 Collaborates
 Cultivates Innovation
 Situational Adaptability
 Communicates Effectively
 Drives Results
 Interpersonal Savvy
 
 For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Nevada, New York City, Ithaca (NY), Westchester County (NY), and Washington residents: 
 
The pay range for this position is between $50,000.00 - $130,000.00
